intended_object: A prototile for tilings of a G-set X: a subset of X (the tile's points) together with a chosen subgroup of its setwise stabilizer in G, which records the tile's symmetries, possibly fewer than the full stabilizer, as with marked tiles in Grünbaum–Shephard. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The structure stores a set `carrier : Set X` and a subgroup `symmetries` of `MulAction.stabilizer G carrier`, the setwise stabilizer of the set under the pointwise action. This matches the module's description. Copies g•P are identified exactly when they differ by a chosen symmetry. Marked tiles, which have fewer symmetries than their point set, are covered by taking a proper subgroup of the stabilizer. Tiles that differ only in their markings are kept apart by their indices in the protoset. Taking a subgroup of the subtype group, rather than a subgroup of G contained in the stabilizer, is an equivalent encoding. The setting is fully general: any group G acting on any type X, with no faithfulness assumed. I found no other Mathlib declaration for this notion.
